title: Misleading on quantity!
text: As far as quality goes I always buy my plants from Costa Farms because their plans are always healthy and high quality. However the issue I have with this subscription box, is it very clearly states in the description that you will get one of the bigger plants and then bare minimum of three or four smaller ones. My box I only got three total. One snake plant and two succulents. Which in my opinion for the size of them was a ripoff for $32. They packed it so they knew that they did not even put the bare minimum of plants in there. Description clearly State you will get one of the snaker ferns or one of the bigger ones, and then at least three or four of the smaller succulents or cactuses. I only got two succulents which look the exact same, one is a little bigger than the other and then I got a snake plant. That is a rip-off for the $32 and I was very disappointed that that's all I got. Probably won't continue the subscription box since they don't actually give you what they claim to.
